passages.provision_quote: A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request made by the student to change the student's: (1) name; or (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student.
passages.note: Enrolled text of the bill he sponsored and voted for; new IC 20-33-7.5 mandates parental notification with no staff safety exception and no permission requirement.

rows.reasoning: Raatz was a Senate sponsor of HB 1608 (2023) and voted Yea on its passage; the enrolled bill's new chapter provides that a school "shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent" of a student's request to change "name" or "pronoun, title, or word to identify the student", which is the rung requiring staff to notify parents whenever a student asks to be treated as a different gender at school. The chapter carries no staff-judgment safety exception, so the rung that notifies parents "unless staff believe it would put the student in danger" is excluded, and it requires notification after the request rather than written parental permission beforehand, so the permission rung is excluded as well.
